MT Framework Sound Tool - README / 请先读我
================================================

中文
----
名称：MT Framework Sound Tool
作者：LuBuCake / Wesky
附带版本：1.0.0.10
许可证：GNU General Public License v3.0（GPL-3.0）
官方源码：https://github.com/LuBuCake/MTF.SoundTool
官方发布与教程：https://residentevilmodding.boards.net/thread/15557/mt-framework-sound-tool
自动下载：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LuBuCake/MTF.SoundTool/main/MTF.SoundTool/MTF.SoundTool.Versioning/MTF.SoundTool/latest.zip
运行要求：.NET Framework 4.8

MTFSoundTool.exe SHA-256：
249799403bceb2558f20a9ea77c4198ac282611711cf0662e867af1dca19876c

重要网络提示：
MT FRAMEWORK SOUND TOOL 可能需要科学上网（仅限 CN 本土），不然程序可能无法完成更新自检，导致无法正常使用。
如果程序启动后长期卡在更新检查，请先检查中国大陆网络环境下的代理或 VPN；这不是 ARC 或 SPC 解析失败。

该程序由原作者独立开发，不属于 CODE X 版 Python 工具。CODE X 不会自动启动、修改或把它打包进 ARC。
发布轻量版时可以删除 MTFSoundTool.exe。CODE X 检测到 EXE 缺失后会从作者维护的
latest.zip 自动下载，只安装目标 EXE，并删除临时 ZIP 和解压缓存。

当前 CODE X 已能将 Resident Evil 6 SPC 解析为独立音频目录，并能从兼容格式的修改音频重建 SPC。MT Framework Sound Tool 仍可作为额外的专业试听、提取、替换和保存工具。使用它保存 SPC 前请自行备份，并保持目标 SPC 文件名和目录位置不变。

English
-------
Name: MT Framework Sound Tool
Author: LuBuCake / Wesky
Bundled version: 1.0.0.10
License: GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0)
Official source: https://github.com/LuBuCake/MTF.SoundTool
Official release and guides: https://residentevilmodding.boards.net/thread/15557/mt-framework-sound-tool
Automatic download: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LuBuCake/MTF.SoundTool/main/MTF.SoundTool/MTF.SoundTool.Versioning/MTF.SoundTool/latest.zip
Requirement: .NET Framework 4.8

MTFSoundTool.exe SHA-256:
249799403bceb2558f20a9ea77c4198ac282611711cf0662e867af1dca19876c

Important network notice:
In mainland China, MT Framework Sound Tool may require a proxy or VPN to complete its update self-check. If that check cannot finish, the application may not start or work normally. This is not an ARC or SPC parsing failure.

This application is independently developed by its original authors and is not part of the CODE X Python tool. CODE X never launches, modifies, or packs it into ARC.
For a lightweight release, MTFSoundTool.exe may be omitted. When the EXE is missing, CODE X downloads the author-maintained latest.zip, installs only the target EXE, and removes all temporary ZIP and extraction files.

CODE X can currently parse Resident Evil 6 SPC into independent audio folders and rebuild SPC from modified, format-compatible audio. MT Framework Sound Tool remains available as an additional professional tool for playback, extraction, replacement, and saving. Back up an SPC before editing it, and keep its target file name and directory unchanged.
